description: Change who receives a flag by targeting site user IDs or emails. Append adds a rule; replace removes all existing rules. Preview first, then apply with confirmed=true after user approval.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

matchBy.description: Whether users holds emails (default) or user IDs.

mode.description: append (default) adds one rule; replace deletes every existing rule first.

users.description: Identities supplied by your site: emails or stable user IDs, according to matchBy.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: add_users_to_flag

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. flag contains the flag identity and configuration, including status, rollout, rules, variants and dependencies when returned; success confirms an applied mutation. targeting reports matchBy, mode, userCount and rule counts before and after.

title: Add users to flag
